params.body:
Pins v0.46.0 in `deploy/gcp/startup.sh`. v0.46.0 is tagged on `287a29a` (main after #138) and holds everything in v0.45.0: the run lifecycle (#133), owner-signed loosening of a lifecycle (#136), the lifecycle served as a policy field (#137) and, new, the removal of the review hand (#138).

- `control-gateway-linux-amd64` sha256 `76e529f606e9d6ee459243a295dcfb9469184faa48a7ac420744bf132e9b94a0`, as listed in the release's `SHA256SUMS`. Checked against the downloaded asset.
- The downloaded binary contains no `vera-seal.key`, `review.publish` or `vera_base`, and does serve `GET /v1/runs`.

This replaces #139, which pins v0.45.0. Pinning v0.46.0 directly means one stop-and-start of the gateway VM instead of two.

After merging, carry it with `deploy/gcp/rehearse.sh upgrade` from a fresh clone. The upgrade stops and starts the VM. If the VM comes back on another firmware measurement than `f21e6b48…`, the gateway will refuse every hand until the logs are rotated again, on the VM and in Elixir's anchors and evidence clone, as on 28 October.
params.title: The gateway runs v0.46.0
